kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتفض (form VIII)
# أَنْتَفِضُ (ʔantafiḍu) /ʔan.ta.fi.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# أَنْتَفِضَ (ʔantafiḍa) /ʔan.ta.fi.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# أَنْتَفِضْ (ʔantafiḍ) /ʔan.ta.fidˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
